messages.content: You are a precise biomedical information extraction assistant. Follow the requested output format exactly and never add explanations.

Given the following text and a relational triplet extracted from it:

Text: Tell your doctor if you also use opioid medicine, herbal products, or medicine for depression, mental illness, Parkinson's disease, migraine headaches, serious infections, or prevention of nausea and vomiting. An interaction with methylphenidate could cause a serious condition called serotonin syndrome.
Tell your doctor if you or anyone in your family has ever had:
- depression, mental illness, bipolar disorder, psychosis, or suicidal thoughts or actions;
- blood circulation problems in the hands or feet;
- alcoholism or drug addiction; or
- if you take Adhansia - an allergy to aspirin or yellow food dye.
- phenylketonuria (PKU), as some chewable tablets contain phenylalanine.
To make sure methylphenidate is safe for you, tell your doctor if you have::
- problems with the esophagus, stomach, or intestines; or
- seizures, epilepsy, or an abnormal brain wave test (EEG).
Triplet: ["Methylphenidate", "has contraindication", "abnormal brain wave test (EEG)"]

The relation 'has contraindication' in the triplet is defined as 'The subject drug should not be used by patients with the condition or characteristic specified by the object entity.' In this context, is there any relation appropriate to replace it? Choose a relation whose meaning and subject/object direction match the triplet even if the wording differs; choose 'None of the above' only if no candidate fits. Please answer by providing only the letter of your choice.

Choices:
A. 'contraindicated in': The subject drug should not be used by patients who have the condition or characteristic specified by the object entity.
B. 'should be avoided with': Patients taking the subject drug should avoid the substance or activity specified by the object entity.
C. 'should not be used in place of': The subject drug should not replace or substitute the treatment specified by the object entity.
D. 'not used for': The subject drug is not indicated or used to treat the condition or situation specified by the object entity.
E. 'has maximum dose': The subject drug should not exceed the maximum dose specified by the object entity.
F. None of the above.

Answer:
